intro.text: A child named in a family record stored in one of the gemstones of Urithiru's archive, left by their mother before she departed the tower.

items.text: About to leave Urithiru, Kmakra's mother was given the chance to leave a message, recorded in a ruby, and used it to set down an account of her family. She called Kmakra and their sibling Molinar the true gemstones of her life.
